retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central figure in metallic gold attire against a pure black void, anchored by a glitter-textured floor and wide-spaced serif typography.
triggerTerms: dramatic studio lighting on black background
excludeWhen: busy or colorful backgrounds are needed
casual or streetwear aesthetics are desired

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio shot of a female figure in a dynamic, wide-legged pose. She wears a shimmering gold metallic top and a cascading, translucent gold chiffon skirt that flows downward. The lighting is sharp and directional, creating high-contrast highlights on the skin and fabric. The background is solid black, with a thin horizontal strip of gold glitter at the very bottom serving as the ground plane. Typography is placed horizontally across the midsection, split by the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a void-like black background
Gold metallic textures contrasting with deep shadows
Horizontal text alignment intersecting the vertical subject
Glitter floor providing a grounding horizontal anchor
coreInvariants: Monochromatic gold color palette for the subject
High-key rim lighting on hair and fabric edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central vertical placement, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face and the golden glitter floor at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the vertical line of the body and flowing fabric down to the glitter floor, then moves horizontally across the wide-spaced text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject on all sides, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright gold highlights and the absolute black background; saturation is focused on warm metallic tones.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

composition.overlap: Text sits behind or is interrupted by the subject's torso

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a rhythmic, architectural feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions with sharp serifs suitable for a luxury look.
The industry standard for cinematic and high-end display serif typography.
High contrast strokes provide the necessary elegance and impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a woman in a dynamic pose against a solid black background. She is wearing a metallic gold top and a long, flowing, translucent gold chiffon skirt. The lighting is dramatic and directional from the side. The bottom 5% of the frame is a horizontal strip of sparkling gold glitter floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase serif text in a gold metallic gradient across the middle of the image. The text should have extremely wide tracking (spacing) so that it spans the width of the frame, with the central letters positioned behind the subject's waist.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking extremely wide?
Does the gold fabric have a translucent, flowing quality?
Is the glitter floor a distinct horizontal element at the bottom?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold metallic sheen
Amount of flow in the chiffon fabric
Density of the glitter on the floor
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Mariah Carey'
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the artist
Do not use any specific record label logos
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the rim lighting separates the subject from the black background
Verify the gold gradient on the text matches the gold of the clothing
Confirm the glitter floor is sharp and textured
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject in Metallic Fashion] + [Solid Black Void] + [Wide-Tracked Serif Typography] + [Textured Ground Plane] to create a high-impact luxury portrait.
